source.title: A Lesson in Grace
source.description: Your technique is very interesting,<name>. A bit rougher around the edges than Sir Dalton, but it has a more "worldly" quality to it that I feel suits me well. Thank you so much, I've already learned so much from you!
source.progress: Through your teachings I feel more connected to the light than ever. I am starting to understand that the role of a <class> is to embrace mercy as much as it is to hone their martial prowess. I will consider this lesson well, and apply what I've learn to bolster our allies!
source.completion: Your squire has grown in skill adventuring alongside you!
